issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (shown with '+' in the class diagram), but the solution implements it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility difference could confuse students about the expected access level when implementing or overriding the method and when calling it from other classes (e.g., tests or helper code).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method signature in Animal match the UML: declare messageOnFeed() as public abstract String messageOnFeed(). Update the solution (and mention in the problem statement if needed) so visibility is consistent across artifacts; subclasses should continue to override the method with public visibility.
